an4.26:1.1: (1) “Bhikkhus, those bhikkhus who are deceivers, stubborn, talkers, imposters, haughty, and unconcentrated are not bhikkhus of mine.
an4.26:1.2: (2) They have strayed from this Dhamma and discipline, and they do not achieve growth, progress, and maturity in this Dhamma and discipline.
an4.26:1.3: (3) But those bhikkhus who are honest, sincere, steadfast, compliant, and well concentrated are bhikkhus of mine.
an4.26:1.4: (4) They have not strayed from this Dhamma and discipline, and they achieve growth, progress, and maturity in this Dhamma and discipline.”
an4.26:2.1: Those who are deceivers, stubborn, talkers, imposters,
an4.26:2.3: do not make progress in the Dhamma
an4.26:2.4: that the Perfectly Enlightened One has taught.
an4.26:3.1: But those who are honest and sincere, steadfast,
an4.26:3.4: that the Perfectly Enlightened One has taught.
